chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He was asked about a man who has a debt upon another man, and with him is the mortgaged property. property; can he buy the mortgaged property from him? He said: Yes.
ai.seo_question: Can a creditor buy the pledged property from the debtor to settle the debt?
ai.summary: Reported by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in al-Kafi, this hadith clarifies that a creditor may purchase the pledged collateral (rahn) directly from the debtor, affirming the mutual consent required in such transactions. This ruling distinguishes the sale of the pledge from the automatic forfeiture often seen in other legal contexts, emphasizing the voluntary nature of the transfer. It serves as a foundational text in Shia fiqh for resolving debt-pledge relationships without necessitating judicial intervention.
